text:
Maria: Quick UX pass on trace header + export flow. Found a11y & copy issues on narrow widths; screenshots in Figma.
Ajay: thanks — can you list the issues so we can triage?
Maria: TL;DR: (1) Export CTA becomes hidden in overflow on small screens and keyboard users can't reach it easily. (2) Copy-corr button lacks accessible name; SR just says 'button'. (3) Downloads are named trace.json which is ambiguous when snapshots are included — users expect a .zip with date/corr id.
Taylor: On mobile the header order is [Back] [Timeline] [Actions]. We move Export into More, which opens a menu but arrow nav is wonky.
Sam: A11y notes from testing:
• If Export is a direct download, do NOT use aria-haspopup="menu". Only add that if it opens a menu.
• Copy button needs aria-label: "Copy correlation id 0a1b2c" and should be DOM-after the id text so SR reads the id first.
• Announce download completion via aria-live polite: "Trace export ready: trace-20260323-0a1b2c.zip".
Maria: Copy suggestions:
• Export CTA text: "Export trace (.zip)" (we usually bundle snapshots). If single JSON only, use "Export trace (JSON)".
• Filename pattern: trace-<corrid>-YYYYMMDD.zip so it's discoverable in downloads.
Taylor: Backend currently uses Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="trace.json". I'll change it to include corr id + .zip when snapshots present and add X-Trace-Filename header so frontend can show expected name before download.
Ajay: Analytics: emit event trace.export with props {method: "header", format: "zip", corr_id: "0a1b2c"} and trace.export_ui_location: "header" | "drilldown".
Maria: Design asks:
• Keep Export visible as primary until viewport really small; prefer hiding Share first.
• On cramped widths show icon-only button but include aria-label="Export trace (.zip)".
• Add keyboard hint in tooltip: "Export (Shift+E)".
Sam: Stacktrace bits:
• Expand frame toggle is icon-only; add sr-only text "Show full stack for frame {n}" and aria-expanded toggles.
• For collapsed long frames change label from "more" to "show full stack" / "collapse stack" to remove ambiguity.
Taylor: Implementation plan:
• Header: CSS grid with min-width for actions + max visible actions before overflow. Swap DOM order for corr-id + copy button on mobile.
• More menu: implement roving tabindex + arrow key handling + focus trap while open.
• Add unit tests for keyboard nav and Axe checks in CI.
Maria: I'll update Figma + i18n keys: export.trace.zip -> "Export trace (.zip)", copy.corr -> "Copy correlation id {id}". Will open PR for copy + markup.
Taylor: I'll open two PRs: frontend header/markup + CSS; backend change for Content-Disposition and X-Trace-Filename. Link PRs in description.
Ajay: assign to eng-platform & eng-runtime, labels: a11y, ux, release: patch.
Deploy-bot: Reminder: add changelog line when PR is merged. :robot_face:
Maria: PR opened: https://git.redwood/test/merge/9001 — includes copy + aria + header order. Backend PR linked in description. Will request a11y review.
Alex: Thanks — small changes but high impact. :thumbsup:
